product_one_liner.value: Fluxco turns transformer specifications into competitive bids from 150+ global OEMs and manages procurement projects end to end for data-center developers, hyperscalers, co-location providers, EPCs, and consulting engineers.
product_one_liner.notes: Fluxco's Account Executive posting (https://fluxco.com/careers/account-executive-data-centers) says the company turns a specification into competitive bids from 150+ global OEMs and manages the project end to end, serving data-center developers, hyperscalers, co-location providers, EPCs, and consulting engineers.

pricing_page.notes: Fluxco's homepage navigation/footer (https://fluxco.com/) lists links such as Careers, FAQ, and Contact, but no pricing page. The FAQ (https://fluxco.com/faq) discusses factors affecting transformer prices; it is not a standalone public pricing page.

named_customers.notes: The homepage (https://fluxco.com/) refers to buyer categories, and the founder interview (https://cleanecon.org/innovation-spotlight-brian-tochman-founder-and-ceo-of-fluxco) mentions only an unnamed customer. I did not find a qualifying customer-logo, case-study, or review page with customer names, so the value is unknown rather than an empty list.

employee_band.notes: Fluxco's Tracxn profile (https://tracxn.com/a/d/company/5903dd7be4b0a9f300ed30a3/fluxco#a:about) lists an official employee count of 13, which falls in the 11-20 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Fluxco's privacy notice (https://fluxco.com/privacy) explicitly describes the company as based in Austin, Texas; the headquarters city is Austin. | hq_country: Fluxco's privacy notice (https://fluxco.com/privacy) says the company is based in Austin, Texas, and its Tracxn profile (https://tracxn.com/a/d/company/5903dd7be4b0a9f300ed30a3/fluxco#a:about) identifies the country as the United States.

founded_year.notes: Fluxco's Tracxn profile (https://tracxn.com/a/d/company/5903dd7be4b0a9f300ed30a3/fluxco#a:about) explicitly lists Founded Year: 2025.

eng_blog.notes: Fluxco's resources index (https://fluxco.com/resources) categorizes its posts as buyer's guides, transformer technical resources, and industry insights. The listed topics concern transformer selection, standards, and industry news, not how Fluxco's product is built; this does not meet the engineering-blog criterion.

public_docs.notes: The homepage footer (https://fluxco.com/) links to FAQ but not product documentation or a developer/help portal. The FAQ (https://fluxco.com/faq) is a single buyer-oriented page, and the resource index (https://fluxco.com/resources) contains transformer guides and industry material rather than product documentation; public product docs are not present.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Fluxco's live software-engineering posting (https://fluxco.com/careers/ai-native-full-stack-engineer) is titled “Full-Stack Software Engineer (AI-Native Generalist)” and includes an application link. The title includes AI, meeting the stated title-based criterion.

model_provider.notes: Fluxco's privacy notice (https://fluxco.com/privacy) refers generally to AI-assisted tools and service providers but does not name a product model or provider. Its software-engineer posting (https://fluxco.com/careers/ai-native-full-stack-engineer) names Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex as coding tools for engineers, not as models used by the customer-facing product. No product model provider was identified in the FAQ or resource index either.

compliance_certs.notes: Fluxco's legal/privacy page (https://fluxco.com/privacy) has a security section describing safeguards but does not publicly claim SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS; the requested-certification list is therefore empty.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: Fluxco's profile identifies Seed as its latest funding-round stage, and the dated funding record (https://www.gaebler.com/VC-Funding-DE10A853-15ED-440C-8C0D-F10CE3B3E6A8-Fluxco-07-27-2026) labels the July 2026 round Seed. | funding_date: Fluxco's funding profile lists the latest round date as 2026-07-27; the dated funding record (https://www.gaebler.com/VC-Funding-DE10A853-15ED-440C-8C0D-F10CE3B3E6A8-Fluxco-07-27-2026) also gives 7/27/2026. The requested YYYY-MM value is 2026-07. | funding_amount_usd: Fluxco's funding profile identifies its latest round as the July 2026 Seed round, and the dated funding record (https://www.gaebler.com/VC-Funding-DE10A853-15ED-440C-8C0D-F10CE3B3E6A8-Fluxco-07-27-2026) reports the round amount as $26,000,000.

raised_18mo.notes: The funding record (https://www.gaebler.com/VC-Funding-DE10A853-15ED-440C-8C0D-F10CE3B3E6A8-Fluxco-07-27-2026) states that Fluxco landed Seed funding on 2026-07-27. That date is within the 18 months before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Fluxco's live job posting (https://fluxco.com/careers/account-executive-data-centers) is titled “Account Executive (Data Centers)” and provides an application link, so it is hiring an account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: The Fluxco timeline on Teardown (https://www.teardown.ai/companies/fluxco) records an August 2026 launch of the Global Transformer Network and says Fluxco publicly launched that positioning and full EPC service. August falls within the six-month window; the evidence is a secondary timeline rather than a primary company announcement.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Brian Tochman's LinkedIn profile (https://linkedin.com/in/briantochman) lists his current Founder and CEO role at FluxCo with a start date of 2026-01-01, within the 12-month window. The profile date supports a leadership start in the period, though he is also identified as a company founder.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The live Account Executive posting (https://fluxco.com/careers/account-executive-data-centers) refers generically to keeping the CRM clean but does not name any CRM or sales/marketing system. The readable job posting therefore supports an empty list of named systems.
